camel_example: aliyun fnf ListSchedules --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken testNextToken --FlowName my_flow_name --Limit 1
description_en: Queries time-based schedules in a flow
kebab_example: aliyun fnf list-schedules --flow-name my_flow_name --next-token testNextToken --limit 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSchedules

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow that is associated with the time-based schedules. The name is unique within the region and cannot be modified after the flow is created. The name must meet the following conventions:

The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
The name must start with a letter or an underscore (_).
The name is case-sensitive.
The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
定时调度绑定的流程名称。该名称在同一地域内唯一，创建后不可修改。取值说明如下：

支持英文字符（a~z）或（A~Z）、数字（0~9）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
首字母必须为英文字母（a~z）、（A~Z）或下划线（_）。
区分大小写。
长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en: For the first query, you do not need to specify this parameter. The system uses the value of the FlowName parameter as the value of the NextToken parameter. When the query ends, no value is returned for this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 首次查询非必填，NextToken是以FlowName作为下次查询的Token，无下一页数据时，该字段不返回
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of schedules that you want to query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.name: limit
